rules.statement: The i_a_*, o_a_ready, o_d_* (except o_d_intg_err) and i_d_ready ports must be the same-named fields of the rv_timer TL-UL device interface tl, with TL-UL meaning.
a_user.instr_type is MuBi4True when i_a_instr is 1 and MuBi4False when i_a_instr is 0.

rules.condition: test bench acting as TL-UL host
rules.statement: The test bench must follow the TL-UL host rules, including keeping A-channel signals stable while a_valid is 1 and a_ready is 0.
The test bench may send requests listed as TL-UL error cases (unsupported opcode, bad size or mask, misaligned address) as legal stimulus.

rules.condition: request is a TL-UL error case (unsupported opcode, bad size or mask, misaligned address)
rules.statement: The device must answer such error-case requests with d_error = 1.
The wrapper must compute a_user.cmd_intg and a_user.data_intg with the OpenTitan TL-UL host integrity generator, so the request carries correct integrity.
Bit 0 of a_user.cmd_intg must be inverted.

rules.condition: request has command integrity error (i_a_intg_flip is 1)
rules.statement: Such a request is a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault that triggers the fatal_fault alert.
o_d_intg_err must be 1 in a cycle where o_d_valid is 1 and the d_user.rsp_intg check fails, and 0 otherwise.
A correct device must never make o_d_intg_err 1.
